name: it_helpdesk
setting: the internal IT helpdesk of a mid-sized company, used by employees
instruction: Which IT team should take this ticket?

options.service_desk: service desk: password resets, account lockouts, access requests
options.endpoint: endpoint team: laptops, desktops, phones and their hardware or local software
options.network: network team: VPN, Wi-Fi and connectivity problems
options.security: security operations: phishing, malware and suspicious activity
options.apps: business applications team: outages and bugs in company web applications

device.description: which device or system is affected
device.question: Which device or system is this on?

location.description: whether the user is in the office or working remotely
location.question: Are you in the office or working remotely?

scope.description: whether only this user or the whole team is affected
scope.question: Is it only you, or are your colleagues affected too?

customer_name.question: May I have your first name, please?
